narr: Thunderstorms moved northwest across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. In Tucson, power poles and trees were downed and some roads were flooded. Flash flooding also occurred in Nogales.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 in 1 hour caused flash flooding and the closure of Camino Verde Rd. near Bilby.
Heavy rain of 1-2 in 1 hour caused flash flooding and the closure of Tangerine Rd. between Interstate 10 and Twin Peaks Rd.
Heavy rain of 1-2' in 1 hour in Nogales, Sonora caused a rapid rise in Nogales Wash. The Doe St. bridge was overtopped and nearby roadways were flooded.
lsr: NOGALES WASH OVERTOPPED DOE ST, BRIDGE AND ALSO FLOODED OTHER ROADWAYS.
